features.title: Log every set
features.pitch: Start an empty workout or one from a template, and log weight and reps, time or distance for each set, in kilograms or pounds. The Previous column shows what you did last time.

features.title: Warm-ups, drop sets and failure sets
features.pitch: Mark a set from its number. Warm-ups stay out of your records, charts and muscle map, and Previous lines them up with last time's.

features.title: RPE, if you want it
features.pitch: Rate how hard each set felt, 6 to 10, from the menu on its number. Off until you turn it on.

features.title: Pause a workout
features.pitch: Stop the clock mid-workout and the pause stays out of its duration. Left one running? Heart offers to end it at your last set. Off until you turn it on.

features.title: A stopwatch for timed sets
features.pitch: Tap play on a timed set and the stopwatch runs, on the lock screen too. Stop it to log the time. Off until you turn it on.

features.title: Keep the screen awake
features.pitch: The screen stays on through your workout and sleeps as usual once you finish. Off until you turn it on.

features.title: Carries, sleds and loaded holds
features.pitch: Log a weight carried a distance, in metres or yards, or held for a time. Records, charts and History count the load and the distance or time.

features.title: Rest timers
features.pitch: Set a rest timer per exercise and it runs between sets, with a notification when it is time for the next one. Settings lists every timer you have set, in one place.

features.title: Your workout on the lock screen
features.pitch: Elapsed time, the next set and your rest on the lock screen, in the Dynamic Island on iPhone or a live notification on Android. Start, extend or skip rest, tick a set. Off until you turn it on.

features.title: Heart, by voice
features.pitch: Start a workout, run your rest and log a set with Siri and Shortcuts, or start one from the app icon on Android. Ask for a record or your week. Off until you turn it on.

features.title: Heart on Apple Watch
features.pitch: Log sets from your wrist with last time's numbers, rest and heart rate. Leave the phone in your locker: the watch keeps logging and the iPhone catches up.

features.title: Templates, as many as you like
features.pitch: Build your own, save any finished workout as one, duplicate any of them, or start from the examples. File them in folders. No cap on how many.

features.title: Exercise library
features.pitch: Search by name, other names, abbreviations like OHP or RDL, muscle words, or with a typo, or filter by muscle, movement pattern, stability and skill. Add your own exercises too.

features.title: Also try
features.pitch: Every exercise suggests others built on the same movement, for when the rack is taken.

features.title: Notes on exercises and workouts
features.pitch: Add a note to any exercise while you train, a cue or a weight to try next time, or one to the whole workout. Signed in, pin an exercise's note and it comes back.

features.title: Still working out?
features.pitch: Leave a workout untouched for a while and Heart asks whether you are still going, so a forgotten session does not run all night.

features.title: Your whole history
features.pitch: Every workout you have ever logged, kept for good. Edit one, correct its times, repeat it or share it, and browse it month by month on a calendar.

features.title: Personal records
features.pitch: Your best set, most reps, best pace, a rep-max table and lifetime totals for every exercise. The workout summary shows each new record as a badge, with the number it beat.

features.title: Charts that go all the way back
features.pitch: Estimated one-rep max, volume, top set and more for every exercise, across your whole history. Switch between a month, three months, a year or all of it.

features.title: A dashboard you arrange
features.pitch: Your profile charts workouts per week, plus any exercise chart you pin to it with one tap.

features.title: Muscle map
features.pitch: A body map on your profile and on every finished workout, shaded by how many sets each muscle group got, with a list and a week-by-week view. Optional; you choose which parts show.

features.title: Goals
features.pitch: A weekly or monthly workout target, or a ladder of milestones with an optional deadline. Goals show up on your charts, and every one you reach links back to the workout that did it.

features.title: Progress photos
features.pitch: Attach photos to any workout, from the camera or your library, and see them all in one strip at the top of History. Photos need an account: they are stored with it, not on the phone.

features.title: Health data beside your training
features.pitch: Resting heart rate, heart-rate variability, sleep, steps, active energy and body weight from Apple Health or Health Connect, charted on your profile. That data never leaves your device.

features.title: Workouts saved to your health app
features.pitch: Finished workouts go to Apple Health or Health Connect, so your lifting counts toward your activity. Heart records how long you trained and never guesses at calories.

features.title: No account needed
features.pitch: Open the app and train. No sign-up, no email. Everything lives on your phone, and signing in later brings it all with you, merged with any other device.

features.title: Sync across devices
features.pitch: Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or connect all three to one account, and your workouts, templates and goals follow you to every device.

features.title: Export or erase everything
features.pitch: Save everything as JSON or CSV any time, offline, with or without an account. Or erase it from the device in one place.

features.title: Bring your Strong or Hevy history
features.pitch: Import the CSV from Strong's or Hevy's export and your workouts, sets and exercises come with you, warm-ups, RPE and notes included. Importing the same file twice never duplicates anything.

features.title: Made for tablets
features.pitch: On an iPad or Android tablet, in either orientation, History and Exercises open side by side, not a phone layout stretched wide.

features.title: English, Spanish, French and Russian
features.pitch: Every screen follows your device's language, down to the exercise library's names and instructions.

features.title: Four themes
features.pitch: Four looks, each with its own type and colours, in light and dark.

features.title: VoiceOver and TalkBack
features.pitch: Buttons, charts, timers and inputs announce themselves to screen readers.

features.title: Your log, by API
features.pitch: Mint a read-only token in Settings and read your own workouts from a script, a spreadsheet or an AI assistant over MCP. Free, and never your health data.
